cards.title: Pattern Transport / Phase
cards.body: Beat/Bar/End use claimed geometry; audio applies both. Phase keeps voices. Stop ramps; Fence keeps origin.

cards.title: Telemetry
cards.body: Audio/control value snapshots; only non-realtime readers lock. Transport has a separate control reader. Drain callbacks before lifecycle handoff. Runtime-only Facade owns OPEN/BUSY drain; its audio-only consumed counter is not proof of a started Voice.

cards.title: Master FX
cards.body: Fixed order filter, delay, reverb, stutter, gate, reverse, crush, cutter; values are 0..1000 and every period derives from the Bar, not wall clock. The single Filter stage also has a typed independent branch (TPT SVF, LP/HP/BP, integer Hz cutoff, milli-percent resonance) with bit-exact OFF bypass; accepted control shadow and audio-applied state/sequence/epoch stay separate. Live Mute/Solo is a per-voice gain gate before the shared FX input: both 64-bit masks apply as one atomic pair over the same bounded lane, muted wins over soloed, the audition sentinel is unreachable, and bytes already inside the shared Delay/Reverb decay on their own.

cards.title: Forbidden boundary
cards.body: No allocation, destruction, lock, Project mutation, quantization, journal I/O or production test hook on the realtime thread. Reclaimed decoded PCM bytes refund Project Banks only; the reserved audition pool contributes no Project reservation refund.
